The FloPlast uPVC half round union bracket in white is a crucial component for robust guttering systems, providing secure and leak-proof joints. This 112mm gutter union bracket is an ideal choice for professional installers working on new build drainage projects and refurbishment works, ensuring a reliable fit for standard half-round gutter systems. Crafted from durable uPVC, it offers excellent longevity and weather resistance. The innovative design incorporates newly extended unions, allowing for additional expansion and contraction to prevent movement and maintain system integrity. Its broad compatibility with most major manufacturers makes it a versatile and practical solution for various installations.
